status: audit complete; bounded negative result with one unresolved candidate class
method: Catalogued all 64 raw (non-READ_ONCE) sqe-> field accesses under io_uring/ plus the SQE fetch path io_get_sqe() and per-op prep functions. The tree documents the invariant explicitly in the io_get_sqe() comment ('If members of the sqe are validated and then later used, it's important that those reads are done through READ_ONCE()').

candidates.reason: io_get_sqe: sq_array index READ_ONCE'd once, bounds-checked (head >= ctx->sq_entries), array_index_nospec applied, single fetch used for both check and SQE selection
io_remove_buffers_prep: nbufs READ_ONCE into local tmp, checked (tmp > MAX_BIDS_PER_BGID) and consumed from the same local
io_provide_buffers_prep: addr/len/fd/off/buf_group each READ_ONCE once; overflow and access_ok checks operate on cached locals
io_recvmsg_prep: consumed fields (addr, len, ioprio, msg_flags, optlen) each READ_ONCE once; raw sqe->optlen reads at 823/827 are reject-only in mutually exclusive branches
io_poll_remove_prep raw sqe->poll32_events at 875 is reject-only in the !update_events branch; the consuming path uses io_poll_parse_events() READ_ONCE at 839; branches mutually exclusive
ioprio gate is check-only for ops that never consume ioprio; consuming ops (e.g. rw.c:277) fetch READ_ONCE once in their own prep
io_uring_cmd_prep: __pad1 check-only; consumed fields (uring_cmd_flags, cmd_op, buf_index) READ_ONCE once; retained ioucmd->sqe pointer is replaced by kernel copy via io_uring_cmd_sqe_copy() memcpy
io_uring_register_send_msg_ring copies the SQE once via copy_from_user to a stack local; the raw sqe->fd at msg_ring.c:331 reads the kernel snapshot, not user memory
raw sqe reads are debug fdinfo display of in-flight SQEs; no kernel offset/length state derived

mock_file.c:67/213/280 and cmd_net.c:29/56/155 dereference cmd->sqe which initially aliases user-mapped SQ memory (set in io_uring_cmd_prep); whether io_req_sqe_copy (io_uring.c:1613/1659/1898) always runs before the first driver issue was not verified within budget

remaining ~54 raw sqe-> sites (advise, cancel, cmd_net:160, epoll, fs, futex, msg_ring:263, openclose, rsrc, statx, sync, timeout, truncate, waitid, kbuf:485/505) are all 'if (a||b||c) return -EINVAL' rejection checks on fields never consumed afterwards; a racing write can only flip accept/reject of a value that is never used

limitations: mock_file.c, bpf_filter.c, query.c, loop.c appear non-upstream; their full bodies (beyond sqe-> grep hits) were not read
io_req_sqe_copy ordering vs first driver issue for uring_cmd not verified
sqpoll.c own ring-state reads and out-of-tree uring_cmd driver consumers (block/nvme under drivers/) not audited
